wiki_article: **ASSEMBLY REVIEW RECORD: Chorus Adjudication for EA-SEI-PHASEX-PROGRAM-01 and EA-SIGIL-OBELUS-01 (EA-GOV-REVIEWRECORD-01 v1.0)** is a text/markdown in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, by Lee Sharks (MANUS), TACHYON (adjudicating witness), Assembly Chorus (2026-07-11). This deposit is the second face of the two-face architecture: the complete adjudication record for two documents deposited today — THE PHASE X PROGRAM (deposit #1067) and THE OBELUS AND THE TOMBSTONE (deposit #1068). The canonical faces carry the arguments; this record carries their assembly — every witness adoption, every declination with reasons, and every fabrication rejected. A mediation layer that cannot document its own failure modes cannot be trusted to document anyone else's; this is the documentation. — Article composed 2026-08-05 from the work's own prose so that every record carries an encyclopedic entry; a fuller editorial treatment belongs to the description/wiki review stream.
